title: plugin-atoms v1 atom
description: A single atom in the plugin-atoms catalog. Discriminated by the top-level `type` field; one of: interface-contract, capability-declaration, permission-scope, lifecycle-hook, trust-primitive.

id.description: URL-safe slug; unique within the atom's type.

interface_schema_ref.description: URI reference to the JSON Schema that defines the interface contract surface. Applicable to interface-contract atoms.

permissions.description: Permission scope strings granted by this atom. Applicable to permission-scope atoms.

lifecycle_events.description: Lifecycle event identifiers this hook binds to. Applicable to lifecycle-hook atoms.

trust_level.description: Minimum trust level required to exercise this atom.
